in_sanskrit.name: विक्रांत
in_sanskrit.meaning: विक्रीयते रात्रिः (vikrīyate rātriḥ) - The one who makes the night active
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power to make the night active and productive, just like a valiant warrior.

in_hindi.name: विक्रांथ
in_hindi.meaning: विकास करना (vikās karnā) - To develop or progress
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name signifies the ability to develop, progress, and overcome obstacles, just like a fearless warrior.

in_tamil.name: விக்க்ராந்த
in_tamil.meaning: விழவ்வுக்கான் ராஜ்யம் (viṙavvukkāṉ rājyam) - The king of valour
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name signifies the possessor of immense courage and the ruler of all situations, just like a brave and powerful king.

in_telugu.name: విక్రంథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name signifies the one who brings victory in all aspects of life, just like a victorious king or a mighty warrior.

in_marathi.name: Vikranth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikranth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has the power to conquer and rule

in_bengali.name: Vikranth
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Powerful Warrior
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vikranth একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has the power to conquer and rule
